title: Senior intelligence official and his wife abducted
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Senior intelligence official and his wife abducted, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Anecdotally, I know of one extremely senior intelligence official who had a pretty gnarly abduction experience along with his wife.
Jim Seivian comes out and blatantly openly talks about a kind of an abduction experience
tellings.difference: Names the official as Jim Semivan of the CIA and says he talks about it openly.
tellings.link_reason: A senior intelligence official and his wife sharing an abduction experience. This is the same account Michels gave without the name.

as_told.title: Jim Semivan and his wife's abduction experience

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says he knows of one very senior US intelligence official who, together with his wife, had a frightening experience of being abducted, taken away by some non-human presence. He gives no name. A writer billed as a CIA historian, Peter Levenda, names the official as Jim Semivan of the CIA, the US spy agency, and says Semivan talks about his abduction experience openly. If true, it would mean such experiences reach people at the top of the intelligence world.
